summary: American ex-Green Beret and convicted fraudster Jack Idema posed as a counterterrorism expert in Afghanistan after 2001, fooled US media with fake claims and footage, and ran a private militia that kidnapped and tortured Afghans until his 2004 arrest.

evidence.note: enlists 1975, Special Forces radio operator, discharged 1984
trains police in Lithuania and invents a black market in Soviet backpack nukes
convicted on about fifty wire fraud counts, four years in federal prison
flies into Afghanistan in late 2001 with a National Geographic crew
abandons aid work and tries to sell weapons to the Northern Alliance
auctions likely staged al Qaeda training tapes; 60 Minutes airs them
feeds invented exploits to Robin Moore for The Hunt for Bin Laden
returns to Kabul in 2004 and forms the Task Force Saber 7 militia
prisoners found beaten, hooded and hung by their feet; judge describes his ordeal
released 2007, tries Dubai, then settles in Mexico running a charter boat
knowingly infects partner with HIV without disclosure; later rape accusation; dies of AIDS 2012

notes: sexual-abuse is based on a roughly five-minute segment on undisclosed HIV transmission and a 2010 rape accusation; reviewer may drop it. Opening segment on other War on Terror freelancers (Faulkner, Colin Berry) treated as context, not subjects. Dubai stay is brief and left out of setting. Military service was minor, so military-officer not used as a role.
